newsitem.title: CHILE: Chile consumer prices rise 6.6 percent in 1996.
newsitem.headline: Chile consumer prices rise 6.6 percent in 1996.

text.p: Chile reported inflation in December of 0.4 percent, which brought the rise in consumer prices for all of 1996 to 6.6 percent, the lowest level in 36 years, the National Statistics Institute said.
The 1996 inflation figure was just 0.1 percent higher than the government target.
Chilean consumer prices rose 0.3 percent in December 1995 and 8.2 percent for all of 1995.
Food prices fell 0.3 percent last month, while housing costs increased 0.3 percent. Clothing prices advanced 0.3 percent, and transport rose 0.7 percent.
A category known as "others" increased 1.2 percent.
